<a id="phase-US-01"></a>
### US-01

- **Phase ID:** US-01
- **Type:** user-story
- **Source UC:** UC-01
- **Title:** As the coordinator, I want one bounded call to fix the whole task graph, so that per-task calls never need to invent IDs, phases, or dependencies
- **Commit type:** feat
- **Commit scope:** —
- **Commit subject:** implement US-01 skeleton-generation agent

**Context:**

This phase repurposes the existing `gaia-generate-work-breakdown` agent so it stops emitting
full task detail (outcome prose, verification commands, grouping rationale) and instead emits
only the schema-v3 skeleton: the full phase/task graph with structural fields
(`id`, `title`, `outcome`, `domain`, `agentType`, `dependsOn`, `acceptanceCriteria`, `estimate`,
`outputCount`, `commit`). This is the single call that fixes IDs, dependencies, domains, and AC
assignment for the whole feature — every downstream per-task call (US-03) and the structural
pre-check gate (US-02, wired in US-04) depend on this output being internally consistent before
any further token is spent. No code outside the agent definition itself changes here; the actual
dispatch of this agent from `pm-phase2.js` is wired in US-04.

**Tasks in this phase:**

- `US-01-TASK-INFRA-01` — repurpose `gaia-generate-work-breakdown.md` to emit the skeleton only

**Depends on phases:** none (independent of INFRA; no code dependency, only a design dependency on the Tech-Spec's schema)
